title: Evaluated Chern arrow through the finite evaluation coordinate
statement: For tower Chern data cX on X, L in Pic(X) and a level n, evaluatedChern(cX,L,n) of [def-sp-tower-class-finite] equals the inverse single comparison of evaluation, followed by the evaluated tower first Chern arrow of L and the finite evaluation coordinate finiteKummerEvaluation of [def-sfb-finite-p1-kummer-coordinates].

source.place: paragraph (1), normalized finite positive Kummer class before direct image

proof.text: Unfold evaluatedChern, mapSingleArrow and finiteKummerEvaluation; both sides are the same composite of exact single and shift comparisons and the shifted line evaluation, up to reassociation.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteP1_evaluatedChern_eq (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (cX : Chern l E X) (L : Scheme.Pic X) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluatedChern l E cX L n =
      ((SpTowerShriek.ev l E X n).mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).inv.app _ ≫
        (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E X n).map (firstChern l E cX L) ≫
        (finiteKummerEvaluation l E cX n).hom
